line: A place over one day, time bent: machines fast, people slow, every cut on a beat of a score written first.
line_cn: 一个地方的一天，时间被弯折：机器快、人慢，每一刀都落在先写好的乐谱节拍上。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: An edit style: the picture is real-looking footage; the style lives in how time is bent and where the cuts fall.
The score is the script: minimal → acceleration → climax → a sudden stop → coda; every cut on a beat or its subdivision.
Machines fast, people slow: traffic and clouds become lines; one fragile thing is slowed.
One fixed-camera time-lapse returns as the clock.
not: Not a travel reel: no drone-porn on a pop track.
Not a news package: no lower thirds, no narrator.
Not a slideshow: motion in every shot.
materials: Photoreal footage: time-lapse, hyperlapse, aerials, slow motion.
Long-exposure light trails at night; crowds as streaks.
A clean digital or 35 mm look; no VHS.

rules: The place's own light: blue hour, sodium orange, noon white.
One accent (sodium orange) for rules, numbers and trails in the assembler.
Consistent grade across the whole film; no per-shot looks.

type.titleFont: a light grotesk, wide tracking, warm white
type.subtitleFont: not used; a handful of numbers and one quote
type.placement: numbers lower-left with a sodium rule; the quote centred at the end
rules: Every number has a source; at most five numbers in the film.
Density follows the score: never cut faster than the current subdivision.
Speed ramps are the transitions; the brake into slow motion is the breath.
The hard stop: a dry cut to black on the bar line with the reverb ringing.

grammar.expresses: the time of day without a caption

grammar.note: slow motion on one fragile thing
slow across a skyline at blue hour

framing: Match shapes across cuts: clock to clock, arch to arch.
People never in close-up except in the slowed moment.

instruments: a single sustained chord for the brake
foley: none, or the slowed thing's own sound at real speed
a city bed compressed by speed
sound.ambience: the place, sped up into a hiss; real speed only in the slowed moment
sound.silence: the hard stop: everything cut on the bar line, reverb left ringing, then the coda alone
sound.voice: none; one quoted line as text at the end
sound.musicDefault: minimal piano arpeggios building to full ensemble, then a hard stop

nativeMoves.name: Light river
nativeMoves.what: Traffic at night becomes a river of trails.
nativeMoves.build: vfx longexposure + timelapse, overhead or high angle, loop link for the climax grid.

nativeMoves.name: The brake
nativeMoves.what: Time crashes into slow motion on one fragile thing.
nativeMoves.build: vfx slowmo, pace still, a 10 s shot placed under the held chord; cue map marks it.

nativeMoves.name: Clock returns
nativeMoves.what: The fixed camera comes back at a new hour.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut from the first clock shot, same framing, 'hours have passed'.

nativeMoves.name: Hard stop
nativeMoves.what: Dry cut to black on the bar line.
nativeMoves.build: assembler fade_black with 0 s duration on a cue-map hit; music cut there.

nativeMoves.name: Shape match
nativeMoves.what: A cut that rhymes two shapes on the beat.
nativeMoves.build: match_cut link; beats describe the matching shape first.

pitfalls.problem: The model produces drone footage with no time bend.
pitfalls.fix: vfx timelapse or hyperlapse on every wide; beats say 'clouds race, traffic streaks'.
Build the cue map first and snap clip boundaries to it in the assembler.
At most five numbers and one quote, all in the assembler.

look.genre: city symphony time-lapse film, documentary, musical montage
look.palette: the place's own light: blue hour, sodium orange, noon white; one consistent grade
look.camera: fixed time-lapse clocks, hyperlapse tracks, aerial rises, one slow-motion breath
look.lighting: natural: dawn, noon, blue hour, sodium night

negative: people are small figures in wide frames, seen from a distance
the camera is tripod-locked or glides on a smooth track
engine.beatSuffix: Photoreal time-lapse: machines and clouds race, people streak, the camera steady.

structures: arrival to departure of one ship
openings: the clock camera before dawn, one light on
a single arpeggio and a still frame
the slowed thing first, then time speeds up
endings: the hard stop and a quiet coda
the clock camera at the same hour next day
the quote over the last trail
